        If ``value`` is a container type, returns a new empty container.

x = {'password': 'a-password-b', 'nested': [{'token-value': 'tok'}]}
assert remove_values(x, ['password', 'tok']) == {'password': 'a-********-b', 'nested': [{'token-value': '********'}]}

assert sanitize_keys({'changed-password': 1, '_ansible_password': 2}, ['password'], frozenset(('changed-password',))) == {'changed-password': 1, '_ansible_password': 2}

cur = value

cur.append('secret')
result = remove_values(value, ['secret'])
